defs.def: a person whose job is to make men's clothes, especially sb who makes suits, etc. for individual customers （尤指为顾客个别订制男装的）裁缝verb

ex.s: It tailors learning experiences to different age groups and learning styles.
ex.t: 它针对不同年龄段和学习风格量身定制学习体验。

ex.s: All camp sessions are created with age-appropriate activities that are tailored to the multiple ways that kids learn.
ex.t: 所有营期都按年龄设计合适的活动，针对孩子多种学习方式量身定制。

ex.s: Lancom is the only product to offer courses tailored to your native language, building on grammar and words you already know.
ex.t: Lancom是唯一提供根据母语量身定制课程的产品，在你已掌握的语法和词汇基础上进行构建。

ex.s: I think the course is tailor-made for you!
ex.t: 我认为课程是专门为你量身定制的！

ex.s: He sees a sign for a tailor’s shop.
C Of course, the CV should be tailored to match the careers in your plan, will leave you well prepared to make the most of all opportunities become available to you.

ex.s: Customers will buy goods that are Tailors are needed in making ads.
